modules.name: naming
modules.summary: Builds resource names (`{org}-{environment}-{region_short}-{name}`) and the standard tag set every module applies.

inputs.name: allowed_environments
inputs.description: Environments this organisation uses. Keep it in step with the OPA policy data (`policies/data/config.yaml`).

inputs.name: cost_centre
inputs.description: Cost centre, added as the `CostCentre` tag.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Environment, the second part of every name. Must be one of `allowed_environments`.

inputs.name: extra_tags
inputs.description: Additional tags. The standard tags (`Name`, `Org`, `Environment`, `Region`, `ManagedBy`, `Owner`, `CostCentre`) always win over these.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: What the resource is for, the last part of the name (e.g. `orders-db`).

inputs.name: org
inputs.description: Short organisation code, the first part of every name (e.g. `acme`).

inputs.name: owner
inputs.description: Team or person accountable for the resource, added as the `Owner` tag.

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: AWS region the resources live in (e.g. `eu-west-1`). Shortened in names: `eu-west-1` becomes `euw1`.

outputs.name: region_short
outputs.description: Short region code used in names, e.g. `euw1`.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Tags every resource gets: `extra_tags` overlaid by the standard tags.

modules.name: s3-bucket
modules.summary: A private, encrypted, versioned S3 bucket that refuses public access and insecure transport.

inputs.name: access_logging
inputs.description: Write server access logs to another bucket. Null turns access logging off.

inputs.name: force_destroy
inputs.description: Allow `terraform destroy` to delete a bucket that still contains objects. Refused in `prod`.

inputs.name: kms_key_arn
inputs.description: Customer-managed KMS key for default encryption. When set, uploads that request a different key are denied. When null, the AWS-managed `aws/s3` key is used.

inputs.name: lifecycle_rules
inputs.description: Extra lifecycle rules: expire or transition objects under a prefix.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: What the bucket is for (e.g. `orders-data`). The bucket is named `{Org}-{Environment}-{region_short}-{name}[-{name_suffix}]`, with `Org` and `Environment` read from the AWS provider's `default_tags` and the region from the provider.

inputs.name: name_suffix
inputs.description: Optional suffix appended to the bucket name, for global uniqueness (bucket names are unique across all AWS accounts). For example a short account ID or random string.

inputs.name: noncurrent_version_expiration_days
inputs.description: Delete previous object versions this many days after they stop being current. Null keeps them forever.

inputs.name: policy_json
inputs.description: Extra bucket policy (JSON from `jsonencode` or `aws_iam_policy_document`), merged with the built-in deny statements (TLS, KMS key). Statements that allow access to everyone (`Principal: "*"`) are refused.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags for this bucket only. Stack-wide tags (`Org`, `Environment`, `Owner`, ...) belong in the provider's `default_tags`; `Name`, `Region` and `ManagedBy` are set by the module.

inputs.name: versioning_enabled
inputs.description: Keep previous versions of overwritten and deleted objects. Refused as false in `prod`.

outputs.name: arn
outputs.description: Bucket ARN, for IAM policies (`<arn>` for the bucket, `<arn>/*` for objects).

outputs.name: bucket_regional_domain_name
outputs.description: Region-specific domain name, for CloudFront origins and VPC endpoints.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Bucket name, built by the naming convention. Known at plan time.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Tags this module sets on the bucket (Name, Region, ManagedBy and your `tags`). The provider adds its default_tags on top.
